findings.finding: European gas (TTF front month, monthly closes) ran ~59 / 70 / 72 EUR/MWh in Jul/Aug/Sep 2026 and ~85 in October, against ~43-46 in Q2 2026 and ~31-35 in Q3 2025, after management said in late July that FY EBITDA would land at the low end of +5-8% with H1 comparable EBITDA only +3.1% and price rises/savings back-loaded to H2 - raising the risk that the Q3 release trims the EBITDA/EPS guide, as Viscofan did at Q3 2025.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (23 Oct amc): FY2025 guide cut from EBITDA +8-12% to +2-6% and net profit to -2/+2% (https://www.merca2.es/2025/10/28/viscofan-ventas-ebitda-2245246/); stock -0.74% on 24 Oct 2025 (Yahoo bars), but it had just fallen 13% on the Hunterbrook report on 14 Oct. Q1 2025 print: -6.85% on 29 Apr 2025. H1 2026 'low end' reassurance: +2.49% on 30 Jul 2026.
findings.original_quote: lleve a compañía a mantenerse en el rango bajo del Ebitda (Bolsamania, 29 jul 2026: '[necessary commercial discipline] to keep the company at the low end of the EBITDA range'); 'el contexto de costes ha cambiado de forma significativa, especialmente en energía' ('the cost context has changed significantly, especially in energy')
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is -6.4% since the 30 Jul close (57.7 -> 54.0) and -4.1% over 60 days while gas rose, and an OCU 'venta' cites raw-material costs. Not fully: no Q3 preview found that quantifies the gas hit, Renta 4 (72.7 target) and Berenberg remain buyers and the Investing consensus is 8 buy / 0 sell with a ~70 EUR mean target - a market braced for a guide cut would show downgrades or a target cut before the print, and none was found. The transmission is a hypothesis: Viscofan's energy hedging and cogeneration electricity sales (which rise with power prices) are not quantified in any source reached.
findings.independence: Company's own H1 language on energy (https://www.bolsamania.com/noticias_print/resultados-anuncios/viscofan-gano-713-millones-hasta-julio-22-y-crece-gracias-al-negocio-de-las-envolturas--23145764.html) and IEA LNG-loss estimate concentrated in 2026-27 (https://www.menorca.info/actualidad/internacional/2026/04/24/2615951/guerra-iran-tendra-impacto-menos-dos-anos-gas-natural-licuado.html); both point the same way but neither quantifies Viscofan's exposure.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 is the first quarter in which currency translation helps reported euros: EUR/USD monthly closes ~1.159/1.134/1.122 (Jul-Sep 2026) vs ~1.169/1.173/1.157 a year earlier, with BRL (~5.6-6.0 vs ~6.2-6.3), CNY (~7.5-7.8 vs ~8.2-8.35) and MXN (~19.7-20.7 vs ~21.4-21.7) also stronger against EUR; H1 reported EBITDA was -7.4% almost entirely on FX, and the FY guide assumed EUR/USD 1.18.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026: EBITDA -8% reported but +7% vs Renta 4 because the FX hit was smaller than expected (-16pp vs -29pp), stock -0.34% next day (https://www.r4.com/articulos-y-analisis/valores/viscofan-1t26-solido-crecimiento-organico-con-esperado-impacto-de-divisas). The FX line has not moved this stock.
findings.why_not_priced: FX rates are public and analysts update them, so most of this is in estimates; the residual is the tendency (seen in Q1 2026, when FX surprised favourably vs Renta 4) for estimates to lag translation, and the fact that a weaker euro also flatters the guide's 1.18 assumption for H2. If priced, the reported-EBITDA bar would already show a return to growth in Q3; no Q3 preview was found to check.
findings.independence: Renta 4 expected the FX drag to ease over the rest of 2026 (https://www.r4.com/articulos-y-analisis/valores/viscofan-1t26-solido-crecimiento-organico-con-esperado-impacto-de-divisas); guide FX assumption from search snippet only (estrategiasdeinversion 403).

baseline_tension: The lean and run-up are flat (-0.37% 20d, +0.37% 5d), so there is nothing to agree with; the one directional finding (energy-driven guide risk) is mildly negative and is partly reflected in the -4.1% 60-day and -6.4% post-H1 drift, which is why p_up is only 4 points below 50.
language_note: The guide language that defines the bar came from Spanish sources only: 'rango bajo del Ebitda' and the energy-cost sentence in Bolsamania's H1 story, and the +5-7% / +5-8% / +3-6% guide in merca2's Spanish write-up of Berenberg.
The disclosed short positions (AKO 1.140% via Europa Press/CNMV; Marble Bar and PDT from a Rankia forum) appeared only in Spanish sources; no English source mentioned shorts.

The only after-close timing evidence for 22 Oct (Rankia post) and the Q3 2025 guidance cut table (merca2) were Spanish; English sources carried only the bare vendor date (TipRanks) and an AI summary of H1 (Quartr).
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance changed: 9.0% median vs 2.3%) and 'size the move on what is new, not the reaction history': abs_move_pct raised from 3.5 to 4.0 because an EBITDA guide trim is live, as at Q3 2025.
'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the FX-tailwind finding rests on public exchange rates, cut from +0.8 to +0.5.
Known capital return (buyback) cut from +0.2 to +0.1 as already public.

'Positioning is the thing to beat' / 'a crowded short is fuel': ~2.3% is not the 18-23% the rule was measured on, so the positioning finding stays at +0.5; 'covered:false is not a zero' already reflected in positioning_check.
'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series / macro-to-company is a hypothesis': the gas finding stays at -1.5 rather than being enlarged, since Viscofan has not quantified its hedges.
